The passage describes events in the 1940s involving Soviet and American forces in Korea, specifically referencing Japanese forces surrendering and the division of Korea at the 38th parallel.  
This context points to the end of World War II, when Soviet troops entered Korea as part of the Allies’ agreement to accept the surrender of Japanese troops in the northern part of the peninsula.  
The Crimean War, World War I, and the Seven Years’ War all took place before the 1940s and are unrelated to this situation.
